dct:title: Miami-Dade Community Health Centers
dct:creator: University of Miami GDSC;Organization;;;https://ror.org/02dgjyy92;ROR;https://ror.org/
dct:description: A point feature class of community health centers in Miami-Dade County. Derived as a subset of all commercial properties within Miami-Dade County with the "DOR Desc" of "CHARITABLE - EXEMPT: HEALTH CARE"
prov:action:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/mdc_community_health_centers/download -p /data/mdc_community_health_centers/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_community_health_centers
cd /data/mdc_community_health_centers

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# download if update flag is set:
if do_update == 1 then
ogr2ogr -nln mdc_community_health_centers download/mdc_community_health_centers.geojson 'https://services.arcgis.com/8Pc9XBTAsYuxx9Ny/arcgis/rest/services/PaGISView_gdb/FeatureServer/0/query?where=DOR_DESC=%27CHARITABLE%20-%20EXEMPT%20:%20HEALTH%20CARE%27&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=json&orderBy=ObjectId 2>&1'

# load into postGIS with:
ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/mdc_community_health_centers.geojson -nlt point -nln mdc_community_health_centers
echo success: mdc_community_health_centers.geojson loaded with ogr2ogr


#########
# Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
####

# remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
UPDATE mdc_community_health_centers
  SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));

# add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
ALTER TABLE mdc_community_health_centers DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
  'mdc_community_health_centers',
  'geom_local', 2236, 'point', 2
);
UPDATE mdc_community_health_centers
  SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(geom,2236)));
CREATE INDEX mdc_community_health_centers_geom_local_idx
  ON mdc_community_health_centers
  USING GIST (geom_local);
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
# Move into corrrect directory and create derivative directory in data package on osgeo
cd /data/mdc_community_health_centers/
mkdir -p derived

# Move into correct directory
cd /data/mdc_community_health_centers/

# Create pg_dump of table SQL in derivate directory on postgis.
pg_dump <postgres opts> -h gaia-db -t mdc_community_health_centers > derived/mdc_community_health_centers.sql

# Create downloadable tarfile of SQL in derivative directory on postgis
rm -f derived/mdc_community_health_centers.sql.tar.gz
tar -czf derived/mdc_community_health_centers.sql.tar.gz meta_dcat_mdc_community_health_centers.json -C derived mdc_community_health_centers.sql
